dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Significant asymmetrical protrusion on the right lateral margin followed by a sharp inward indentation before the posterior taper.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate-grey median pixel intensity consistent across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Dense, irregular distribution of dark-pixel clusters (mottling) covering approximately 70% of the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the pigmented mottling and the baseline grey skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast white linear mark located on the anterior-left dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white linear scar on the anterior-left region and a significant structural deformity/indentation on the right lateral margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme lateral asymmetry in the planar contour between the left and right margins.
